rows.what: The agent service's role type is an enumeration of five roles (Admin, Initiator, Application, Reader, Monitor); a role outside it is not representable.
KNOWN_ROLES is the role set the agent service reports as knownRoles in a roleNotRecognized refusal (admin, initiator, application, reader, monitor).
The role type has a Default value (Monitor), commented as the value for an empty claims structure in tests and scaffolding; the code does not state it as the role of an unspecified stored entry.
The authority rule for assigning roles is code: only Admin may assign Admin; Reader, Application and Monitor may assign no role.

The community service lists seven built-in roles and states in a comment that they are fixed by the build and are never defined, replaced or deleted through vtc/roles/*; custom roles are a separate record kind (vtc-service/src/acl/roles.rs:2-5).

The second-party consent threshold for unrestricted admin actions is a configuration value (key unrestricted_admin_consent_threshold) whose built-in default is 1; the default action lifetime is 72 hours.
The approvals model reads an absent minApprovals as 1 (floored at 1) and an absent excludeRequester as false.
The wallet's grantAdmin task states the role name admin literally; the name is not read from a declaration.
The wallet uses the role name vetter when a community's requirements name no vetter role.
The wallet reads an absent minApprovals as 1 and an absent excludeRequester as false.
Creating a community VTC takes a default threshold of 2 where none is given, and accepts only human-kind agents as founding admins.

rows.what: Managing network rules requires a membership whose role string is admin or founding_admin; the check is a route-level comparison outside the policy engine.
The specification text states that an unrecognised role confers no authority and must not fall back to a default role, and that the role set and ceilings are recorded in Appendix C.
The annex describes the monitor role as the least-privileged role and the default for an unspecified entry.
